system.description:
Built on Project FU's Commander.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points
  • martial melee proficiency
  • martial ranged proficiency

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise.)

CAPTAIN SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000049]{Queen's Gambit} 【Max SL 6】

Action: free attack with an equipped weapon, High Roll 0. After it resolves, choose one: an ally who can hear you recovers (5 + SL × 5) HP, or use Bishop's Edict, Charging Cavalry or King's Castle for free (still paying its MP).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000050]{Bishop's Edict} 【Max SL 5】

Action + 10 MP, until your next turn, choose one: all MP costs are doubled, or all sources of damage deal (SL × 3) extra. "All" means everyone on the battlefield — allies, enemies and you.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000051]{Charging Cavalry} 【Max SL 5】

Action + 10 MP: one ally who can hear you performs a free attack (a basic attack if an NPC) at +(SL) Accuracy, High Roll 0. Works on allied NPCs.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000052]{King's Castle} 【Max SL 4】

Action + 10 MP, until your next turn, choose one: no creature can recover HP or MP, or all MP-restoring effects restore (SL × 5) more. The lockout is total and includes your own side.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000053]{Crushing Chariot}

After using Bishop's Edict, Charging Cavalry or King's Castle, choose a Player Character who can hear you and has not yet acted this round: they take their turn immediately after yours. Grants nobody an extra turn — it decides whose comes next.
